id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Point-to-point die-to-die (D2D) Link between two chiplets on a single package, built from 1, 2, or 4 uni-directional modules per direction. A multi-chiplet SoC contains multiple UCIe Links. Switched fabrics (e.g. CXL switches) are constructed by the carried protocol on top of UCIe-attached chiplets, not by UCIe itself.

supported_topologies.name: Single-module Link
supported_topologies.description: One uni-directional module per direction between two chiplets; 1x bandwidth (16 lanes Std / 64 lanes Adv).

supported_topologies.name: Multi-Link SoC
supported_topologies.description: Several independent UCIe Links interconnecting multiple chiplets on one package.

supported_topologies.name: Protocol-level fabric
supported_topologies.description: CXL/PCIe switches and pooled memory built by the carried protocol over UCIe-attached chiplets (e.g. CXL switch chiplets, co-packaged optics).

master_slave_role_summary.description: Originates/terminates the carried protocol (PCIe/CXL/Streaming); presents Flits over FDI.
Reliable delivery: Flit framing, 16-bit CRC + Retry, link-state management, parameter negotiation, Arb/Mux; FDI up, RDI down.
Die-to-die I/O: AFE/clocking, bump map, training, lane repair/reversal, sideband; RDI up.
Uni-directional physical unit (16 or 64 data lanes + Valid + Track); 1/2/4 modules form a Link.
Always-on 800 MHz auxiliary channel for the whole Link (management/training/registers).

fields.interconnect_role: UCIe is a die-to-die transport between two chiplets. The D2D Adapter guarantees per-Link delivery via CRC + Retry (Flit Mode); the Physical Layer carries the bits source-synchronously over a very short on-package channel. UCIe is transparent to the carried protocol's transactions — it transports PCIe/CXL/Streaming, it does not route or reorder them above the Flit level.

ordering_guarantees.flit_sequence: Flits are delivered in order per Link; the Flit-header sequence number drives retry/replay.
ordering_guarantees.protocol_ordering: Transaction-level ordering is the carried protocol's responsibility (e.g. PCIe/CXL ordering rules) above FDI.
ordering_guarantees.arb_mux_fairness: When multiple protocols share a Link, the Adapter's Arb/Mux arbitrates fairly so none is starved.
ordering_guarantees.raw_mode: In Raw Mode UCIe provides no Flit-level ordering/integrity; the protocol owns it.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: UCIe itself is addressless transport; address spaces belong to the carried protocol — PCIe (Memory/IO/Config/Message), CXL.mem (HDM coherent memory), CXL.cache (coherent caching), CXL.io (I/O), or a Streaming protocol's own address model. UCIe's own control plane is the sideband-accessible configuration registers.

device_classification.base_die: Central SoC die hosting multiple UCIe Links to satellite chiplets.
device_classification.memory_chiplet: CXL.mem memory expander mapped over FDI.
device_classification.streaming_chiplet: Chiplet carrying AXI/CHI/SFI/CPI or symmetric coherency over Streaming/Raw.
device_classification.switch_chiplet: CXL/PCIe switch or co-packaged-optics die connected via on-package UCIe.
